de: A synod at Blachernae convened by anti-Unionist Greek clergy condemns the former pro-Unionist patriarch John XI of Constantinople.

dz: 拜占庭帝国与威尼斯共和国缔结条约. 除了同意十年休战外,威尼斯人还被分配到君士坦丁堡的一个商业季度,并恢复了早先的特权.
de: The Byzantine Empire and the Republic of Venice conclude a treaty. Apart from agreeing on a ten year truce, the Venetians are alloted a commercial quarter in Constantinople and are restored to earlier privileges.
